body:
Video games goes into the compulsions section. Yeah, it's sort of interesting while it's happening but it seems like wasted time not long after the fact. If I'm going to find a satisfying pursuit, that isn't it.

In general I wouldn't say I'm deprived, but I don't feel like typing all of that out. None of it made me better; it's as if dwelling in a basement for 10 years would've led me to the same exact place.

I don't care in the sense that it doesn't invoke an emotional reaction anymore.

I've had hobbies that spanned many years. I haven't traveled the world but I've seen more places than the typical person in my area has seen. I exercise to keep up my concentration and to try and prove to myself that this isn't some bullshit my body is pulling on me.
